posts.title: Simple
posts.description: Simpler things are better. I don't know what I can say other than that. This font. Little bear blog. Pen and paper. One brand. One road, one way, one focus. One book of poems by the side of the bed. An area of history. A cup of tea before sleep. One window.

posts.title: What they don't tell you about books
posts.description: Most books are like wrapping paper To get you excited about What you already have Or otherwise would know
